claim: DiT (Peebles & Xie) replaces the U-Net with a transformer on latent patches; DiT-XL/2 reaches FID-50K 2.27 on ImageNet 256x256, SOTA at the time.
quote: we initialize the MLP to output the zero-vector for all alpha; this initializes the full DiT block as the identity function

claim: DiT patchifies the 32x32x4 VAE latent into p x p patches giving T=(I/p)^2 tokens; halving p quadruples token count and Gflops, and higher-Gflops DiTs consistently reach lower FID.
quote: We find that DiTs are scalable architectures for diffusion models... DiTs with higher Gflops -- through increased transformer depth/width or increased number of input tokens -- consistently have lower FID.

claim: adaLN-zero regresses scale/shift from the summed timestep+class embedding and zero-inits the residual modulation, beating cross-attention and in-context conditioning while being most compute-efficient.
quote: The adaLN-Zero block yields lower FID than both cross-attention and in-context conditioning while being the most compute-efficient.

claim: Stable Diffusion 3 (Esser et al. 2024, arXiv 2403.03206) builds on DiT with the MMDiT backbone trained under reweighted Rectified Flow.
quote: Stable Diffusion 3 ... reweighted Rectified Flow formulation and MMDiT backbone

claim: MMDiT uses separate weights for image vs text modalities but joins their sequences for a shared attention op; SD3 uses two CLIP encoders plus T5, scaling from 15 blocks/450M params to 38 blocks/8B params without saturation.
quote: separate sets of weights for the two modalities ... joining the sequences of the two modalities for the attention operation ... 15 blocks with 450M parameters to 38 blocks with 8B parameters

claim: FLUX.1 (Black Forest Labs, Aug 2024) is a 12B-parameter rectified-flow transformer using a hybrid of multimodal (MMDiT) and parallel diffusion transformer blocks in the latent space of an image encoder.
quote: All public FLUX.1 models are based on a hybrid architecture of multimodal and parallel diffusion transformer blocks and scaled to 12B parameters.

claim: FLUX conditions on T5-XXL plus CLIP, concatenates text and image tokens for joint attention in MMDiT 'double-stream' blocks, then switches to 'single-stream' parallel blocks; Schnell is a 1-4 step distilled variant.
quote: hybrid architecture of multimodal and parallel diffusion transformer blocks

claim: OpenAI's Sora uses a DiT backbone operating on spacetime patches of video latents that act as transformer tokens, letting it train across variable resolutions, durations and aspect ratios.
quote: Given a compressed input video, we extract a sequence of spacetime patches which act as transformer tokens ... Sora is a diffusion transformer.

claim: PixArt-alpha (Oct 2023) is a DiT-based T2I model that injects text via cross-attention modules added to the DiT block, reaching near-SOTA quality at ~1% of the training cost of RAPHAEL.
quote: incorporating cross-attention modules into Diffusion Transformer (DiT) to inject text conditions and streamline the computation-intensive class-condition branch

claim: Hunyuan-DiT (Tencent, May 2024) is a multi-resolution diffusion transformer with fine-grained Chinese+English understanding, redesigning the transformer, text encoder and positional encoding and adding multi-turn multimodal dialogue.
quote: Hunyuan-DiT, a text-to-image diffusion transformer with fine-grained understanding of both English and Chinese

claim: The official facebookresearch/DiT PyTorch repo has ~8.6k GitHub stars.
quote: GitHub Stars: 8.6k stars ... official PyTorch implementation ... replacing the traditional U-Net architecture with transformers that operate on latent patches.

claim: The official black-forest-labs/flux inference repo has ~25.6k GitHub stars.
quote: GitHub Stars: 25.6k stars ... official inference repository for FLUX.1 models by Black Forest Labs.
